title: Autodesk generative design
description: Documented public constraint-driven design tool (Autodesk) for the Constraint-Driven Invention Engine capability area.
body:
Autodesk generative design is a documented constraint-driven design tool from Autodesk. Cloud generative-design solvers inside Fusion 360 that take loads, constraints, materials, and manufacturing methods and generate optimized geometries satisfying all constraints.

How it works: It works by evaluating the objective on a dense grid over the search interval and returning the best point found, with the evaluation count recorded.

title: Z3 theorem prover
description: Documented public constraint solver (Microsoft Research) for the Constraint-Driven Invention Engine capability area.
body:
Z3 theorem prover is a documented constraint solver from Microsoft Research. High-performance SMT solver used to find solutions to logical and arithmetic constraint systems — the engine behind many program-synthesis and verification tools.

How it works: It works by comparing the dimension vectors of every term in the equation against the first term's, flagging any term whose units disagree.
